mapping.summary: Cloud purchase planning: demand forecasts and vendor-grouped order proposals written back to BC
claims: Dashboard with inventory value, stock turns, stock health and stock-out/overstock alerts
ABC/XYZ classification with a policy suggestion per cell
Forecasts include demand inherited from parent assemblies
Projects stock against safety stock, reorder point and incoming orders
Proposals grouped per vendor, ordered in one click back to BC
Stock-out detection for stocked and non-stocked items
Configurable lead-time source priority: item, vendor or item-vendor
Per-vendor lead-time buffers, transport time, order costs and minimum order quantities
Planning parameters kept outside BC master data
Runs as a hosted cloud app connected to BC data
